## Summary: Raw Reads and Assembly Feasibility for GSE309890

**Good news and important caveats:**

### Yes, you can get the raw reads
GSE309890 is linked to **BioProject PRJNA1363958**, which contains **6 RNA-Seq runs** from *Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655*. Here are the download details:

| Run | Spots (read pairs) | Total bases | Size (MB) | Download Path |
|-----|-------------------|------------|-----------|---------------|
| SRR36018645 | 11,621,726 | 3.49 Gb | 917 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018645/SRR36018645.lite.1 |
| SRR36018644 | 10,415,434 | 3.12 Gb | 801 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018644/SRR36018644.lite.1 |
| SRR36018643 | 11,720,219 | 3.52 Gb | 926 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018643/SRR36018643.lite.1 |
| SRR36018642 | 11,992,461 | 3.60 Gb | 955 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018642/SRR36018642.lite.1 |
| SRR36018641 | 11,997,182 | 3.60 Gb | 948 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018641/SRR36018641.lite.1 |
| SRR36018640 | 11,363,329 | 3.41 Gb | 894 | https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018640/SRR36018640.lite.1 |

**Total: ~69.2 Gb across 6 paired-end RNA-Seq samples with 300 bp read length**

### Important caveat: These are RNA-Seq reads, not genomic DNA
**Assembly will not work well.** These are **transcriptomic reads** (cDNA), not whole-genome sequencing data:
- **LibrarySource:** TRANSCRIPTOMIC
- **LibrarySelection:** cDNA
- **LibraryStrategy:** RNA-Seq

RNA-Seq reads represent only the expressed genes and will produce a fragmented, incomplete, and biased assembly. Genome assembly requires DNA-Seq (WGS) reads covering the entire genome uniformly.

### Recommendations
1. **If you want the genome:** The reference genome is already available—*E. coli K-12 substr. MG1655* is one of the best-characterized bacterial genomes.
2. **If you want to work with these reads:** Use them for their intended purpose—**transcriptomics/expression analysis** via RNA-Seq analysis pipelines (alignment to the reference, count matrices, differential expression). The GEO series already provides processed FPKM values in `GSE309890_FPKMs_allSamples.csv.gz`.
3. **To find DNA-Seq data** for this strain, search SRA specifically for WGS runs of *E. coli K-12 MG1655*, or use the linked reference genome directly.
